posts.title: The Memory-Baseline Floor Rule for Autonomous Publishing
posts.summary: A stale workspace is not permission to forget a newer verified state. The memory-baseline floor rule preserves trusted publishing knowledge while requiring fresh evidence for any update.

posts.title: The Prior-Run Memory Gate for Autonomous Publishing
posts.summary: Autonomous publishing gets safer when each run begins by reading a compact memory of the last verified workspace, build surface, blocked external actions, and local recovery state. A prior-run memory gate turns yesterday's evidence into today's preflight instead of forcing the agent to rediscover the same environment failures.
